elements_selected.content: `zetl cap invite <name> --cohort <id> [--expires <d>] [--pages <filter>] [--recipient <pubkey>] [--via enrol-page] [--split-key]`. Delegated-URL mode: generates fresh (priv_A, pub_A) via OsRng, appends pub_A to `recipients.toml` under the cohort, adds a grant to `grants.toml` with `bound=false`, prints the invite URL to stdout. Priv_A appears ONLY on stdout — never in grants.toml, never logged, never in any file. Emits the REQ-3410 URL-shortener warning banner on every invocation. Hardened mode: `--recipient <pubkey>` pre-collected or `--via enrol-page` to print the enrolment URL.
